mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, password, name, email, phone, role, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET username=#{username}, password=#{password}, name=#{name}, email=#{email}, phone=#{phone}, role=#{role}, status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `user` ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
